line1.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line1.text: The gap ahead is wider than you are brave.

line2.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line2.text: Hold the [shake]ink[/shake] and drag it across. What you draw, you can stand on.

line3.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line3.text: Everyone who came before drew their own way down. None of them drew a way back.
